analysis_scope: offline static analysis only; the recovered WebTop URL was not opened

webtop.url_recovery: The five-byte native fragment is XOR-decoded by sub_9A494, and the 51-byte template is XOR-decoded by sub_9A4EC before Java_com_WebTop_getMainUrl formats it.

constructor.behavior: Starts a worker thread running sub_862D4.

worker.behavior: Waits until the qplay handle is available, resolves the obfuscated exports, then installs hooks.

installed_hooks.behavior: Runs the original function and then invokes registered callbacks.
Dispatches through a registration list before falling back to the original function.
The export name identifies this as anti-Frida logic; the replacement body was not needed for the old-client analysis.

conclusions: Spectron is a separate 2.2 native build with obfuscated C++ exports, not a drop-in replacement for the 1.8 library.
The bridge contains a generic ARM64 inline hook engine and waits for libqplay.so before resolving its target exports.
The recovered WebTop URL belongs to the modding layer. It is not evidence of the original login endpoint, and it was not contacted.
None of the nine Spectron export names can be transferred by address or name into the 1.8 library without an independent function-level proof.
